title: Arkret Message

anyOf.$comment: forbidden encrypted content carrier; canonical name is encrypted_content
forbidden track selector; the Message schema identity fixes the discussion family

track_name is a payload-only field of message_create_payload; the materialized Message resolves its track through the referenced Strand and MUST NOT duplicate it. See zh/models/strand-and-message.md 9.1 and forbidden-wire-fields.json `track_name/message`.
forbidden Message extension metadata; canonical path is metadata.fields or encrypted_metadata

id.description: For ak.message.create, the reducer derives this value by retyping the creating Event.event_id's full 33-byte / 44-character token from ak:event: to ak:message:. It is not independently producer-chosen.

effective_scope.description: Read-only immutable effective scope of this Message, materialized from the accepted Event.scope_ref after the receiver verifies it against the Strand's frozen pre-state (models/circle.md §6.1-§6.2). kind='realm' for Realm-default scope; kind='circle' when the Message's Strand was Circle-scoped at write time. A later Strand scope rebind MUST NOT reinterpret already-written Messages. This field MUST NOT appear in actor-supplied content payload (reason=effective_scope_reducer_managed).

encrypted_content.description: Encrypted envelope whose plaintext is the Message ContentBlock.

encrypted_metadata.description: Encrypted envelope whose plaintext is a message_metadata object.

state.description: Top-level lifecycle state for messages. Messages do not have a separate deleted/tombstone state; retention or moderation removal uses ak.message.redact and state=redacted so the message slot and audit metadata remain stable.

state_changed_at.description: Reducer-derived timestamp of the most recent state transition. MUST be set when state != 'active'; MUST be the created_at of the corresponding ak.message.redact Event. Aligns with the common-fields rule in models/common-fields.md §3.

revision_root_id.description: First revision in this message's edit chain. The first revision MUST have revision_root == id. Maintained by ak.message.revise reducer.

redaction_ref.description: Required when state=redacted; references the accepted ak.message.redact Event id that produced this state. A cross-object ak.redaction can never be the source: its payload class excludes Message targets, so this reference is single-valued and unambiguous (models/common-fields.md 5.1 Message exemption). MUST be absent for other states.

updated_by.description: Reducer-derived actor that produced the most recent materialized message update, such as ak.message.revise or ak.message.redact.

mentions.description: Structured direct mention AST nodes for this Content Block. This is the only carrier of a direct mention: authorization, notification routing and audit attribution read mention_node.subject_account_id exclusively, and compare it as a complete AccountId (zh/models/strand-and-message.md §9.4.1-§9.4.2).

audience_mentions.description: Structured broadcast mention AST nodes for this Content Block (zh/models/strand-and-message.md §9.4.3).

attachments.description: Profile-defined attachment hints. At most 32; canonical durable attachment relations SHOULD use Relation attached_to.

not.$comment: Mirror of event-payload.schema.json $defs.content_block: reject discriminator field `type` (canonical: `kind`), composite child array name `blocks` (canonical: `parts`), and byte-count field `size` (canonical: `size_bytes`). Keeps materialized Message and Event payload schemas in lockstep so that the materialized Message.content cannot smuggle through wire-forbidden field names.

body.description: Inline text body. Authoritative bound is 256 KiB UTF-8 bytes enforced by a byte validator; maxLength is a not-wider code-point fast bound. Longer bodies MUST use ak.content.long_text (zh/models/content-types.md section 4.1.4).

message_metadata.description: Extensible user-readable Message metadata. In MLS / E2EE realms this object is encrypted as encrypted_metadata unless the Realm explicitly opts into plaintext metadata.

sidecar_exchange_binding.description: Agent Sidecar exchange binding. Legal only inside encrypted_metadata plaintext of an event whose signed scope_ref.kind is sidecar; forbidden in plaintext metadata and shared Realm/Circle events.

not.$comment: Reducer-owned fields stay top-level and MUST NOT be mirrored inside metadata.

metadata_fields.description: Profile-defined Message metadata fields. Reducer-owned lifecycle and revision fields are forbidden here to avoid dual sources of truth.

$comment: Top-level uses unevaluatedProperties (not additionalProperties) because the top-level oneOf branches contribute evaluated properties; additionalProperties at the top level would not see those and could wrongly reject legitimate oneOf-branch fields (JSON Schema additionalProperties/oneOf pitfall).
